_comment: Final V1 runs. All use the physical structure (Air / Pd S/D / Al2O3 / HfO2 / Conductor gate) and the stepped SOLVE VSTEP/VFINAL sweep. shared_overrides apply to every thickness on top of config/iwo_material_model.yaml. per_thickness_overrides: the fitted band mobilities (declared FITTED) and, for 6.3 nm only, the DEVICE-SPECIFIC flat-band offset (Qf 8.7e10 instead of the shared 1.73e12, i.e. +0.29 V) required by that film (user request 2026-09-21: tune 6.3 nm too). The untuned 6.3 nm validation run is kept as the entry 6p3_validation. 31.8 nm excluded by the user.

2p0.note: calibrated: shared Qf + fitted mu_band 18.13; physical structure, stepped sweep (rescored under the median-floor KCL rule, see NUMERICAL_CONVERGENCE G')

13p2.note: calibrated: shared Qf + fitted mu_band 61.9; physical structure, stepped sweep

6p3.note: TUNED: device-specific Qf 8.7e10 (+0.29 V vs the shared value; cause NOT DETERMINED) + fitted mu_band 11.69; physical structure, stepped sweep

6p3_validation.note: VALIDATION with the shared parameters only (Qf 1.73e12, mu_band 12.4): shape reproduced, threshold -0.29 V

31p8_excluded.dir_note: excluded by the user; run_0006 (laws + shared Qf + series R): Ion -6 % but always-on baseline not reproduced; run_0010 (back-surface hypothesis) aborted in SOLVE INIT without error text.
